(1) hyper-parameters have a significant effect on recommendation performance when using Word2vec for creating item embeddings, (2) hyper-parameter values that work for NLP tasks do not necessarily work for recommendation tasks, and (3) optimizing hyper-parameters is a key factor for achieving good results when using Word2Vec for recommendation tasks.

hyperparameter values for Word2vec applied to a recommendation task are significantly different from hyperparameter values for the original task, and that the most influential hyperparameter values for this task are not those usually tuned for Word2vec.
